headlines: U.S. wraps up its counter-IS troop mission in Iraq
Costume records at the Berlin Marathon
description: U.S. forces complete their withdrawal from Iraq's counter-Islamic State mission; the Pentagon orders a 20% cut in general and admiral positions; Morocco's king appoints the country's first woman prime minister, who now has to build a coalition; central Tokyo breaks its record with 35 straight days of rain; and Guinness World Records certifies costume records at the Berlin Marathon.
